channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump says U.S. warship's 9-month deployment 'not nearly long enough'
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln has been deployed for nearly nine months and is slated for replacement in the Middle East.

item.title: Renovation workers uncover $10 million in gold at construction site
item.description: Police warned unauthorized individuals to stay away from the site after the discovery.

item.title: Community gathers to thank firefighters after Washington wildfires
item.description: After fires near Spokane destroyed hundreds of homes and displaced over 65,000, residents show gratitude to firefighters during recovery.

item.title: Five killed in Northern Michigan; suspect found dead, officials say
item.description: Authorities investigate the deaths of five people in rural Northern Michigan; the suspect was also found dead.
